 Resurrection Fest 
 Festivals in Galicia in 2027: thirteen already have dates, from Resurrection Fest and Atlantic Fest to Caudal Fest
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Pau 
 17 Nov 2026, 18:30 
 A 4-minute read 
 Fernando Marmolejo / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Thirteen Galician festivals already have official dates for 2027 , from Riot GZ Fest in Lugo on 13 February to Caudal Fest, also in Lugo, on 17 and 18 September. 
 July brings the biggest events : Resurrection Fest with Evanescence and Mötley Crüe, Atlantic Fest with Interpol, the 15th anniversary of PortAmérica, and Ortigueira, between 30 June and 18 July. 
 Caudal Fest has revealed the most of its line-up outside metal , with La Oreja de Van Gogh, Viva Suecia, Sidonie and Niña Polaca to close the summer in Lugo. 
 Several are selling passes without a single artist announced : PortAmérica, Son do Mar and Vendaval, while O Son do Camiño has not even announced its dates yet. 
 Galicia's festival calendar for 2027 is starting to take shape. As of 17 November, thirteen Galician festivals have announced the dates of their next edition on their official websites or social media, and almost all of them are selling passes. Some, such as Resurrection Fest and Caudal Fest , already have much of their line-up in place; others are asking their audience to buy blind. We list them by date, with what is known about each one.
 Festival guide 
 Resurrection Fest 2027 
 30 Jun – 3 Jul 2027 · Campo de Fútbol de Celeiro (recinto junto al puerto de Celeiro), Viveiro 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 February to May: Riot GZ, ExpoRock, Facela and Ouren Sound
 The season kicks off in clubs and arenas, with festivals lasting one or a few days.
 Riot GZ Fest (Lugo, Saturday 13 February). It returns to Sala Tebras , from 18:00. The first tier of tickets, at €29, has sold out, and tickets are now on sale at €32 , plus a 5% fee per order. There is no line-up on its website yet.
 ExpoRock (A Coruña, Saturday 13 March). The second edition takes place at EXPOCoruña , from 12:00 to 03:30, with La Pegatina, Narco, Los Enemigos, Lendakaris Muertos and Catalina Grande Piñón Pequeño. General admission costs €43 including fees. We covered it in our story on the ExpoRock line-up .
 Facela Fest (Lugo, 5 to 9 May). It grows to five days, with The Pains of Being Pure at Heart heading a first announcement of indie guitars, shoegaze and noise. The pass costs €40 , and €25 for under-25s, as we explained in the first Facela Fest 2027 announcement .
 Ouren Sound Fest (21 and 22 May). Its website has already announced the 2027 dates in the province of Ourense, again in May and with one day fewer than in 2026. The line-up does not yet appear on the official website.
 June and July: from Millo Verde and Resurrection to Atlantic Fest
 Most of the action comes with the summer, especially in July, when several of Galicia's best-attended festivals coincide.
 Millo Verde (Redondela, 3, 4 and 5 June). Redondela's alternative festival celebrates its twentieth edition . For now, its website only confirms the dates.
 Galicia Fest (Vigo, from 25 June). Camilo opens the 2027 programme on 25 June at the port of Vigo, with tickets on Ticketmaster . ModoFestival may receive a commission if you buy through this link, at no extra cost to you. The remaining nights are yet to be announced; his Spanish tour is covered in Camilo at the 2027 festivals .
 Resurrection Fest (Viveiro, 30 June to 3 July). It is the furthest ahead: 72 bands confirmed, with Evanescence, Mötley Crüe, Parkway Drive and Lorna Shore as headliners, plus Helloween, Dropkick Murphys and Kreator. Passes cost from €235 including fees. The full line-up is in our story on the first Resurrection Fest 2027 announcement .
 Festival de Ortigueira (7 to 11 July). The Festival Internacional do Mundo Celta will have five days of folk. Its first name is Belgian group Aérokorda , who won the 2026 Concurso Runas and with it their place at the 2027 edition.
 PortAmérica (Portas, 8, 9 and 10 July). It celebrates its 15th anniversary at the Azucarera de Portas and is already selling passes, although it has not announced any artists or chefs.
 Atlantic Fest (Vilagarcía de Arousa, 16 to 18 July). Interpol is its first confirmation. Friday and Saturday take place at Praia da Concha and Sunday in the streets of the town. The pass is in its second tier, at €75 including fees, and the website warns that it will rise to €80. More in our story on Atlantic Fest 2027 .
 Vendaval Fest (Ribadeo, 23 and 24 July). A Mariña's rock and punk festival is preparing its fifth edition and sold its first passes at €20 in a 24-hour promotion that ended at midday this Tuesday, as we reported in our story on the Vendaval passes .
 Son do Mar (Meaño, 23, 24 and 25 July). It is selling two-day passes at €40 and three-day passes at €55 , plus an 8% fee per order, without any artists announced. The details are in our story on Son do Mar 2027 .
 A concert at Festival de Ortigueira during the 2019 edition. Image: Quique-ast / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) September: Caudal Fest closes the summer in Lugo
 Caudal Fest will return on 17 and 18 September to the grounds of the Pazo de Feiras e Congresos in Lugo with seven names already announced: La Oreja de Van Gogh, Viva Suecia, Sidonie, Niña Polaca, Puño Dragón, Gara Durán and Rata . There is no day-by-day breakdown yet. Two-day passes went on sale at €47 including fees at their launch price and can be bought on Enterticket . ModoFestival may receive a commission if you buy through this link, at no extra cost to you. More in our story on the Caudal Fest 2027 line-up .
 Blind passes and festivals still without dates
 Three of the thirteen, PortAmérica, Son do Mar and Vendaval , have put 2027 passes on sale without announcing a single artist. It means a cheaper pass in exchange for buying without knowing who is playing, trusting in what the festival has programmed in previous years.
 Other big Galician festivals have not yet announced their dates. This is the case for O Son do Camiño , which brought Linkin Park and Katy Perry to Monte do Gozo in 2026, as well as SonRías Baixas, Morriña Fest and Río Verbena, which, according to ABC, have yet to confirm their 2027 details. We will add them as they are announced. The full list, with filters, is at festivals in Galicia , and the summer schedule is in the festival calendar for July to September 2027 .
 Sources: official websites of Riot GZ Fest, ExpoRock, Ouren Sound Fest, Millo Verde, Resurrection Fest, Festival de Ortigueira, PortAmérica, Atlantic Fest, Son do Mar and Caudal Fest, consulted on 17 November 2026; Ticketmaster (Galicia Fest); Vendaval Fest's official Instagram; ABC, 16 November 2026; previous ModoFestival coverage.
